text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After pleading earnestly with her
Trainer, 
Rhein Kraft secured her entry into the 
Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Yushun Himba (Oaks),
the 
Umamusume of her generation were
surprised 
by Rhein Kraft's unconventional rotation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Rhein Kraft pointed out: taking 
on the NHK Mile Cup while running the 
entire Triple Tiara was an unprecedented 
challenge in itself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her battle to tread an uncharted path was 
about to begin.
